checks.check: connection: the server answers PING and claude-mem reports the BullMQ queue healthy
the worker consumes the prefix the server enqueues under
enqueue and process: an event's job completes and stores one observation
the job is in BullMQ under claude-mem's prefix, with its deterministic evt_ id, and completed there
a burst of 20 events: every job completes, one observation and one provider call each
retry: a rate-limited job waits in BullMQ's delayed set for its backoff, then completes on attempt 2
failure: a job rate-limited every time fails after its 3 attempts, in Postgres and in BullMQ's failed set
checks.detail: failedReason "stub: rate limited on every attempt"

checks.check: non-retryable error: the job fails on its first attempt and stores nothing
operator retry: POST /v1/jobs/:id/retry re-enqueues the failed job in BullMQ and it completes
cancel: a job cancelled while it waits is removed from BullMQ and never runs
worker down: 10 events wait in BullMQ's wait list, none is lost
server restart (append-only file on): the 10 waiting jobs are still there after it
worker back: the 10 jobs are processed, one observation each
a retry's backoff survives a server restart: the delayed job stays delayed, then completes
claude-mem restart: server and worker come back, earlier jobs keep their state, new jobs run
two workers: 12 slow jobs are shared between them, each processed exactly once
session end: the summary job (the second queue) completes
at the end: nothing left active or waiting, and no job reported stalled
checks.detail: event: 48 completed, 1 failed; summary: 1 completed, 0 failed
